schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Scope dev dependency commits as deps-dev
Group Bun runtime updates, which release in lockstep
Group all @types packages but @types/bun, which moves with the bun group
Group Storybook packages, which must share one version
Group oxlint with its type-aware backend and the ESLint plugin that turns off the rules oxlint covers, which tracks oxlint's rule set
Group ESLint with its bundled rule configs
Hold the typescript-eslint-ts alias on TypeScript 6: TypeScript 7 ships no JavaScript API, which typescript-eslint needs (see docs/development.md)
Batch image and action digest bumps into one weekly PR
Auto-merge minor, patch and digest updates once CI passes; the main ruleset still requires a human approval
